title: Way smaller than it sounds, check dimensions
text: Way smaller than it sounds, check dimensions. Item is not large or jumbo as described. To small to fit any of the blankets I have, is sized more like a purse.’ine also had a pink stain on the zipper like from lipstick maybe? Not the nicest imagine. It’s probably partly my fault as I didn’t look up the dimensions, I figured since my blanket I wanted to put in it is thin it would be fine but that was my mistake.
